title:
Emails that sound
like Indigen World
lede: One clear, blue design for every message we send: decisions, feedback, support and receipts.

review-feedback-desktop.png.title: Feedback you can act on
review-feedback-desktop.png.note: Reviewer notes sit in their own labelled panel, with one button back to your work. Actual rendered email, synthetic example.

approved-phone.png.title: Approved means approved
approved-phone.png.note: Status pills use the backend's own decision and always carry a written label. Actual rendered email at 375 px.

password-reset-phone.png.title: Account emails stay direct
password-reset-phone.png.note: A clear button, a copyable fallback link and what to do if you did not ask. Synthetic, non-working link.

dark-phone.png.title: Readable in dark mode
dark-phone.png.note: Mail apps that follow your device's dark setting get matching colours. Actual rendered email, forced dark.
